blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Very-high-resolution Earth-observation satellites acquire more data than they can store and downlink, while in maritime surveillance the vessels cover a tiny fraction of each scene. We study onboard vessel detection as a way to select what is downlinked, which reduces the data according to its content rather than coding every pixel; it is complementary to conventional onboard compression. The work follows three axes. (i) Data and algorithm: a controlled dataset is generated from 68 annotated Maxar scenes with 43 vessel classes, and a YOLOX-S detector is trained on it. (ii) Embedded deployment: the detector is quantized and deployed on the DPU of a Versal VC1902, with a limited loss of detection quality and a processing time of a few seconds per scene. (iii) Data reduction: we propose several downlink modes, from metadata only (box, class and score of each detection) to image crops around vessels, tiles holding detections, or the whole scene with a degraded background, and estimate from the measured detection errors the trade-off each offers between the vessels kept and the volume downlinked. On our dense harbor and coastal scenes, tiles keep 98% of the vessels with 29% of the scene volume, and crops 83% with 3%.
blocks.zh: 甚高分辨率 地球观测卫星获取的数据比存储和下行链路多,而在海上监视中,船只覆盖每个场景的一小部分。 我们研究舰载探测,作为选择下行链路的方法,根据数据的内容减少数据,而不是对每个像素进行编码;这是对常规舰载压缩的补充. 作品遵循三轴. (一) 数据和算法:从68个注解的Maxar场景生成一个有43个船级的可控数据集,并培训一个YOLOX-S探测器。 (二)嵌入式部署:探测器被量化并部署在Versal VC1902的DPU上,检测质量损失有限,每个场景的处理时间为几秒. (三) 数据减少:我们提出了几种下行链路模式,从仅元数据(box, class and rices of every survey)到船舶周围的作物图像,瓷砖持有检测,或整个背景退化的场景,以及从测量检测错误中估算出船舶所保存的每项报价与数量下行链路之间的权衡。 在我们密集的港口和海岸景点上,瓷砖保留了98%的船体,占场容的29%,农作物的83%,占3%.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Very-high-resolution optical EO satellites acquire scenes of hundreds of megapixels to gigapixels.
Data volumes grow faster than downlink capacity, and the onboard mass memory must buffer the data until a ground station is in view [ 1 ] .
In maritime surveillance this pressure is paradoxical: most pixels show open sea, while vessels occupy a very small fraction of the scene.
Downlinking every pixel with the same priority spends most of the capacity on content without mission value; small, sparse vessels on large sea areas are therefore a natural first case for onboard selection.
blocks.zh:
甚高分辨率光学EO卫星获得成百上千像素的场景。
数据量增长快于下行链路容量,机上质量内存必须缓冲数据直到地面站被查看 [1].
在海上监视中,这种压力是自相矛盾的:大多数像素显示出出出海面,而船只占据了场景的极小部分.
将每个具有同样优先地位的像素下行连接起来,将大部分能力用于内容而不具有任务价值;因此,大型海域上小型而稀少的船只是船上选择的第一个自然案例。

blocks.en:
Conventional onboard compression (CCSDS 122/123 [ 2 , 3 ] ) reduces the number of bits per pixel but does not know where the useful content is.
An onboard detector adds this knowledge: the satellite can downlink only the detected boxes, image crops around vessels, or the whole scene with a more compressed background (selective coding). Detection suits this purpose: a box locates each object compactly, directly defines the crop or tile to keep and takes a few bytes as metadata, whereas a segmentation mask is costlier to describe and transmit.
Such semantic selection is applied before the existing codecs and complements them; moving processing closer to the sensor in this way reduces latency and downlink volume [ 4 ] .
Content-dependent reduction already exists in coarser forms: Φ \Phi -Sat-1 discards cloudy images on board [ 5 ] , and cloud screening combined with CCSDS-123 avoids transmitting cloudy pixels [ 6 ] . Object detection makes the selection finer, at object level, and specific to the mission target.
blocks.zh:
常规机载压缩(CCSDS 122/123 [2,3])会减少每个像素的位数,但不知道有用的内容在哪里.
机上探测器会添加这种知识:卫星只能将探测到的盒子,船只周围的图像收成,或者整个场景具有更压缩的背景(选择性编码). 检测适合此目的:一个框将每个对象紧凑地定位,直接定义要保存的裁剪或瓷砖并取出几个字节作为元数据,而分块口罩则更昂贵地描述和传输.
这种语义选择在已存在的解码器之前被应用并补充;以这种方式使处理更接近传感器会减少延迟和下行链路音量 [4].
内容依赖的还原已经以粗体形式存在:\\Phi-Sat-1在机上丢弃多云图像[5],与CCDS-123结合进行云筛选可避免传输多云像素[6]. 对象检测使选择更精细,在对象级别上,并针对任务目标.

blocks.en:
Onboard AI has also been demonstrated in orbit, e.g. the Φ \Phi sat-2 processing chain [ 7 , 8 ] and OPS-SAT cloud segmentation [ 9 ] .
Onboard object detection has been studied on high-resolution imagery [ 10 ] , including YOLOX [ 11 ] on an on-orbit FPGA [ 12 ] ; ship detection in optical imagery is widely studied on the ground [ 13 ] . Our team has shown the benefit of onboard YOLO-family detectors [ 14 , 11 ] for ships [ 15 ] and for building damage assessment [ 16 ] , integrated in a reactive ground–space loop [ 17 ] .
These works focus on detection quality and embedded feasibility; the data reduction that the detections actually allow, with their errors, on real scenes, is rarely quantified.
blocks.zh:
机载AI也在轨道上被演示出,例如:\\Phi sat-2处理链[7,8]和OPS-SAT云分解[9].
已就高分辨率图像[10]对机上物体探测进行了研究,其中包括在轨FPGA [12]上的YOLOX [11];在地上广泛研究了光学图像中的船舶探测[13]. 我们的团队展示了舰上YOLO-家族探测器的好处[14,11],用于舰只[15]和建筑损害评估[16],这些探测器集成于反应性的地-空间回路[17]。
这些作品侧重于检测质量和嵌入式可行性;检测实际允许的数据减少,加上其错误,在真实场景上,很少量化.

blocks.en: This paper quantifies this data reduction, and ties it to the detector performance measured on controlled data and on the target hardware: a YOLOX detector is trained on a controlled maritime dataset generated from annotated Maxar scenes, quantized and deployed on the DPU accelerator of a Versal VC1902 device at one operating point, and its measured errors are used to estimate the downlinked volume of several selection modes on real scenes.
blocks.zh: 本文量化了这一数据减少,并将其与在受控数据和目标硬件上测量的探测器性能联系起来:一个YOLOX探测器在附加说明的Maxar场景生成的受控海上数据集上被训练,在一个操作点将一个Versal VC1902设备的DPU加速器上被量化并被部署,其所测量出的错误被用来估计真实场景上几种选择模式的下联量.

blocks.en: Method
blocks.zh: 方法

blocks.en:
Reducing the downlinked data with AI is not a single algorithm but a processing chain, from the acquisition of an image to its downlink (Fig. 1 ). The camera delivers raw data, which are first corrected on board, e.g. restoration of acquisition effects [ 18 , 19 ] and co-registration, e.g. against a compressed latent reference uplinked from the ground [ 20 ] . The corrected scene, too large to be processed at once, is cut by a tiler into tiles (e.g. 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 pixels). Each tile then goes through the AI stage, here vessel detection, which outputs detection products (boxes, classes, scores); a mosaicer gathers the tile results into a scene-level result, and a selection stage uses it to decide what is written to the mass memory and downlinked. Tiling and mosaicking are presented in a companion paper [ 21 ] .
Our vessel detection, which enables the data reduction, is thus one stage of this more complete chain; this paper covers the AI stage, which works tile by tile, and the selection it drives.
Our data are already corrected ground products, cut into 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 tiles by our own dataset generator, so neither the onboard corrections nor the tiler are applied here.
Within this scope, the method is organized along three axes: the data and the detector (axis 1), its embedded deployment (axis 2), and the use of its outputs to reduce the downlinked data (axis 3).
blocks.zh:
减少与AI的下行链路数据不是一个单一的算法,而是一个处理链,从获取图像到其下行链路(图1. 相机提供原始数据,首先在机上更正,如恢复获取效应[18,19]并进行同机登记,如与地上相接的压缩潜在参照物[20]。 被修正的场景太大,无法一并处理,被一平板切成平板(例如:1024×1024 1024\times 1024像素). 每块瓷砖再经过AI阶段,这里是容器检测,它输出检测产品(箱,类,分数);一个苔藓将瓷砖结果收集成场景级结果,一个选择阶段用它来决定写给质量内存和下行链接的内容. 平和相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
因此,我们的船舶探测能够减少数据,是这一更完整的链条的一个阶段;本文涵盖人工智能阶段,它用瓦片制成瓦片,以及它所驱动的选择。

在这一范围内,该方法按照三个轴来组织:数据和探测器(轴 1),其嵌入式部署(轴 2),以及使用其输出来减少下行链路的数据(轴 3).

blocks.en: Axis 1: Data and Algorithm
blocks.zh: 轴1:数据和算法

blocks.en:
Controlled dataset generation. Cutting annotated scenes naively gives a dataset dominated by empty background, poor in rare classes, with neighboring tiles shared between training and test, and with no link back to the scenes. We therefore developed a controlled generation algorithm that turns annotated scenes into training and evaluation tiles, so that these choices are explicit and measurable and the scores can be trusted and traced back to the scenes. Its input is 68 Maxar Standard (2A) pansharpened scenes (4 bands, 16-bit; RGB used) of harbors, coastal areas with dense traffic and canals, with a ground sampling distance of 30 to 70 cm, annotated by an expert with 43 vessel classes (42 types and a generic “vessel” class).
Each scene is converted to 8 bits with a per-scene 2–98 % percentile stretch and cut on a regular 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 grid, the same grid as the onboard tiler ( grid tiles , Fig. 2 b).
The generator then controls four properties of the tiles it produces.
blocks.zh:
受控数据集生成. 剪接附加说明的场景天真地给出了一个以空背景为主的数据集,在罕见的班级中穷,相邻的瓷砖在训练与测试之间共享,与场景没有联系. 因此,我们开发了一个可控的生成算法,将附加说明的场景转化为训练和评价牌,使这些选择是明确而可衡量的,并且可以信任得分并追溯到场景. 其投入为68 Maxar Standard (2A) pansharpened scene (4个波段,16位;RGB用) 港口,交通和运河密集的沿海地区,地面采样距离为30至70厘米,由43个船级(42个类型和通用"船"级)的专家作注释.
每个场景被转换为8个比特,每平方位有2–98%的百分位拉伸并切入了正1024×1024 1024\times 1024格,与机上平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面
生成器然后控制所出瓷砖的四个属性.

blocks.en: • Empty tiles. Every grid tile containing a vessel is kept, but only 30 % of the empty tiles, drawn at random, so that the background does not dominate (Fig. 2 a). • Class balance. Extra tiles centered on vessels ( centered tiles ) are added: on a few vessels of each dense tile (about N / 2 \sqrt{N}/2 for N N vessels), and on vessels cut by the grid. This adds views of rare classes and of whole vessels without adding one tile per vessel, which would over-represent moored ships. • Spatial split. Blocks of neighboring tiles are assigned to training, validation or test (80/10/10 %), so that a vessel normally belongs to a single subset. The centered tiles can however overlap a block of another subset, so some vessels appear in two subsets. • Traceability. Every vessel keeps an identifier linking it to all tiles that contain it, to its scene and to its scene coordinates; inverting this record gives the vessels of each tile (Fig. 2 c).
blocks.zh: • 空瓦片。 每个含有容器的网格平板都保留下来,但只有30%的空瓦片,随机取出,这样背景就不会占主导地位(图2 a). • 班级余额。 添加了以船只(以砖块为中心)为中心的额外瓦片:在每个密集瓦片的几个船只上(N / 2\sqrt{N}/2对N 船只),以及被栅格切割出的船只上. 这增加了稀有类别和整艘船的视野,但没有每艘船增加一瓦,这将会成为停泊的船只。 • 空间分割。 相邻的瓦片块被分配到训练,验证或测试中(80/10/10 %),这样一个容器通常属于单个子集. 然而,中间的瓷砖可以与另一个子集的块相重叠,因此有些船身会分出两个子集. • 可追踪性。 每艘船都有一个识别符,将它与包含它的所有瓷砖相连接,与它的场景及其场景坐标相连接;倒转这个记录可以使每块瓷砖的舰只(图2c)相接.

blocks.en: Detector training and evaluation. On these tiles we train YOLOX-S [ 11 ] , a recent member of the YOLO family [ 22 ] chosen for its accuracy/cost trade-off and its compatibility with the Vitis AI flow; it predicts a box, a class and a confidence for each vessel, and is trained in floating point for 100 epochs. The validation tiles later serve to calibrate the quantization (axis 2), and the test tiles, restricted to grid tiles as produced by the onboard tiler, only to measure the scores. Since only finding a vessel matters for data retention, detection is evaluated separately from classification, with the usual IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 matching, as a function of the confidence threshold. Scores are reported at the deployed threshold of 0.30, which balances missed vessels and false alarms; the data reduction (axis 3) uses a lower one, which favors keeping vessels.
blocks.zh: 探测器培训和评估。 在这些瓷砖上,我们训练了YOLOX-S [11],YOLO家族的一位最近成员[22]以精度/成本取舍及其与Vitis AI流相容性入选;它预言每个船会有一个盒子,一个班级和一个信心,并接受100个纪元的浮点训练. 验证瓦片后来用于校正分数(轴2),而测试瓦片则限于由机上平板所出出格来分数. 由于只发现容器保存数据的问题,检测与分类分开评估,通常IoU ± 0.5\克 0.5匹配,作为置信阈值的一种函数. 记录的分数在部署的0.30分阈值上,这平衡了漏出的船只和假警报;数据减少(轴3)采用较低的分数,有利于保持船只。

blocks.en: Axis 2: Embedded Deployment
blocks.zh: 轴2:嵌入式部署

blocks.en: Target and quantized model. The detector is trained in floating point, but the target computes with 8-bit integers (int8): the model must therefore be quantized before it is deployed, which affects its detection performance. The target is the VCK190 evaluation board, built around a Versal VC1902 device [ 23 ] , an adaptive-compute architecture evaluated for space edge computing [ 24 ] . It combines Arm Cortex-A72 cores with a DPU (deep-learning processing unit) accelerator on the AI Engines and programmable logic. The model is quantized by Vitis AI post-training quantization, calibrated on the validation tiles, then compiled for one operating point: DPUCVDX8G in its C32B6 configuration (six batch handlers of 32 AI Engine cores, one compute unit), i.e. batches of six tiles, with a 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 input (Vitis AI 3.0). The effect of quantization and deployment is measured by comparing the quantized model with the float one, on the test set and with the same metrics.
blocks.zh: 目标与量化模型. 探测器被训练为浮点,但目标以8位整数(int8)来计算:因此模型在被部署之前必须被定量,这影响了它的探测性能. 目标是VCK190评价板,围绕一个Versal VC1902设备[23]而建,一个适应性-计算架构,评价为空间边缘计算[24]. 它将Arm Cortex-A72核心与AI引擎上的一个DPU(深学习处理单元)加速器和可编程逻辑结合. 该模型由Vitis AI训练后分解分解而成,在验证瓦上校正后被编译为一个操作点:DPUCVDX8G在其C32B6配置(6批处理器为32个AI引擎芯,1个计算单元),即分批分出6个瓦,其输入量为1024×1024 1024\times 1024 (Vitis AI 3.0). 量子化和部署的效果通过将量子化模型与浮点模型,在测试集上和同分量度进行对比来测量.

blocks.en: Inference pipeline and hardware measurements. The C++ inference code runs on the Arm cores and drives the DPU through the Vitis AI runtime, in three stages per batch: pre-processing (CPU) scales the 8-bit tiles to the quantized model input (input scale); inference runs on the DPU; post-processing (CPU) does what the network does not, i.e. output rescaling, box decoding, confidence threshold and per-class non-maximum suppression (NMS). All processing stays at tile level, and reading the tiles from the board storage (an SD card) is not counted, since on board they would arrive as a stream from the tiler. Over these three stages, the latency of each stage is measured per batch, the throughput is derived in Mpixel/s, and the board power is read from its INA226 power-monitoring chips, sampled every 2 ms. Together they give the energy needed per tile and per scene, split into a static part (board at rest) and a dynamic part (increase during processing).
blocks.zh: 推论管和硬件测量. C++推导码运行于Arm核心上并驱动DPU通过Vitis AI跑出时间,每批分出三个阶段:预处理(CPU)将8位平分的平分平分到分数模型输入(输入比例);推导运行于DPU上;后处理(CPU)做网络不做的事,即输出回分级,箱解码,置信阈值和每等非最大压制(NMS). 所有处理都停留在瓦片级别上,从棋盘存储器(一种SD卡)中读取瓦片不计算,因为在机上它们会以从瓦片中流出来. 在这三个阶段中,每批量测出每个阶段的耐久性,吞吐量以Mpixel/s来推导出,并从其INA226功率监测芯片上读取板功率,每2ms取样. 它们共同提供每个瓦片和每个场景所需的能量,分出一个静态部分(板子休息)和一个活性部分(处理过程中增加).

blocks.en: Axis 3: Data Reduction by Onboard Filtering
blocks.zh: 轴 3: 通过机上过滤减少数据

blocks.en: Downlink modes and data model. The detections of the deployed model then decide what is downlinked. Four modes are compared, from the most to the least reduced (Table 1 ). Metadata sends only one record per detection (box, class, score), with no image: the ground learns where the vessels are, but cannot see them. Crops adds a small image around each detected box, the cheapest way to see the vessels. Tiles sends every grid tile holding at least one detection, which also gives the vessels’ surroundings and tolerates a missed vessel next to a detected one. Selective coding sends the whole scene, with the crops at full quality and the background compressed with a ratio CR, so that nothing is discarded. They are compared with the full scene, which is the usual product, before any onboard compression. For each mode, the table gives the downlinked content, its size in bytes, the main risk due to detection errors, and what sets its volume. The modes can also be combined in time over downlinks of different rates and availability, e.g. a low-rate link available often and a high-rate link during ground-station passes [ 25 ] (Fig. 1 ): the most reduced products give the ground an early view of the scene, and less reduced ones follow, possibly on ground request. We quantify the volume of each product, not the link schedule.
blocks.zh: 下行链路模式和数据模式. 然后对部署的模型进行检测,然后确定哪些是下行连接的。 比较了四种模式,从最多到最少(表1)。 元数据每次检测只发送一则记录(box,class,分数),没有图像:地上会学习容器的位置,但看不到. 作物在每个被探测到的盒子周围增加了一个小的图像,这是最廉价的看船的方法. 轮胎发送出每个网格瓦片,至少持有一个探测器,这也给船只周围,并容忍在被探测器旁边漏出一艘船. 选择性编码会发送整个场景,收成达到完全质量,背景压缩成比例为CR,这样就不会丢弃任何东西. 在任何机上压缩之前,它们都比作整个场景,这是通常的产品。 对于每个模式,表格给出了下行链接的内容,其大小以字节表示,由于检测出错而导致的主要风险,以及设置其音量的是什么. 这些模式也可以通过不同速率和可用率的下行链路在时间上结合,例如,地面站通过时经常有低速连接和高速连接[25](图一):最被降低的产品让地面早日看到场景,而较少的则随之而来,可能根据地面请求. 我们量化每种产品的数量,而不是链接时间表。

blocks.en: Table 1: Downlink modes compared in this work. m m : crop margin; CR: background compression ratio. Size: images as raw data of 12 bits per band, packed (4.5 bytes per pixel, 3 bands); a detection record holds two box corners in tile coordinates ( 4 × 10 4\times 10 bits), the class (6 bits), the score (8 bits) and the tile index (11 bits), i.e. 65 bits.
blocks.zh: 表1:本作中比较的下行链路模式. m m: 裁剪边距; CR: 背景压缩比. 大小:图像作为每个波段12位的原始数据,被打包(每像素4.5个字节,3个波段);一个检测记录在平板坐标(4×10 4\times 10比特),类(6比特),分数(8比特)和平板指数(11比特)中有两个盒子角,即65比特.

blocks.en: From detection errors to downlinked volume. The detector makes two kinds of errors: false negatives (missed vessels), which may lose information, and false positives (false alarms), which only add volume. Their effect depends on the mode. A missed vessel is lost with metadata and crops, survives in a tile if a neighbor in the same tile is detected, and remains, compressed, in the background with selective coding. A false alarm costs a record or a crop, but a tile only when it falls on an empty tile. Since a lost vessel cannot be recovered on the ground, whereas a false alarm only costs volume, the estimation uses a lower threshold than the deployed one (0.10 instead of 0.30). This is where the previous steps come in: the errors of the deployed detector, measured on the test set, are applied to the tiles and vessels of each of the 68 scenes to estimate the order of magnitude of the downlinked volume and of the vessels lost; for selective coding, the background compression ratio CR is treated as a parameter, from mild to strong compression. The result depends strongly on the scenes. Ours are harbors, coastal areas with dense traffic and canals, which is a nominal case when such areas are tasked; on open sea, vessels are much sparser and the reduction would be much larger, so our figures are conservative.
blocks.zh: 从检测出错到下行链接的音量. 探测器有两种出错:假底片(出错的容器),可能丢失信息;假底片(出错的警报),只增加音量. 它们的效果取决于模式. 被误用的容器会随着元数据和收成而丢失,如果在同一瓷砖中的相邻者被检测出,在有选择性地编码后仍会留在瓷砖中存活,并被压缩. 假警报需要记录或收成,但只有落在空地上时才需要瓦片. 由于失事船只无法在地上取回,而虚假警报只花费大量费用,因此估计使用的门槛低于部署的门槛(0.10而不是0.30)。 前面的步骤就在这里:在测试集上测量的所部署的探测器的错误被应用到68个场景中的每个场景的瓷砖和相轮上来估计下行相接体积和所损失的相轮的大小;对于选择性编码,背景压缩比CR被作为参数,从轻到强压缩. 其结果在很大程度上取决于场景。 我们的港口、交通繁忙的沿海地区和运河,当这些区域被分派任务时,这是名义上的情况;在公海上,船只比较稀少,减少的要多得多,所以我们的数字是保守的。

blocks.en: Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 实验和结果

blocks.en: Axis 1: Data and Algorithm
blocks.zh: 轴1:数据和算法

blocks.en: Generated dataset. The generator produces 13 967 tiles (Table 2 ); keeping 30 % of the empty grid tiles leaves two fifths of empty tiles in the dataset, enough to learn the background without letting it dominate. Even after class balancing, the class distribution stays very unbalanced (Fig. 3 ): four classes hold 80 % of the vessels, and the 33 least frequent classes each less than 1 %. The rarest classes occur in only a few scenes, so the spatial split cannot place all of them in every subset; the test set nevertheless roughly follows the overall distribution. It holds 1 596 vessels; since each tile is processed on its own, the 53 vessels cut by the grid are scored in each of their tiles, i.e. 1 649 boxes.
blocks.zh: 生成的数据集 。 生成器生成了13,967个瓦(表2);保留了30%的空网格瓦在数据集中留下了五分之二的空网格瓦,足以学习背景,而不会让它占据主导地位. 即便在班级平衡后,班级分布仍然非常不平衡(图3):4个班级持有80%的轮船,33个最不常见班级各不到1%. 最罕见的类只出现在少数场景中,因此空间分化不能将它们全部放入每一个子集;然而,测试集大致遵循了整体分布. 它拥有1 596个船;由于每块瓦片都是自己处理的,因此被网格切割的53个船被打入了每块瓦片,即1 649个箱子.

blocks.en: Table 2: Dataset split (68 scenes). A vessel in two subsets is counted in both. Test: grid tiles only.
blocks.zh: 表2:数据集分拆(68场景). 两个子集中的一个容器在两个子集中计算。 试验:只用网格瓦.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Share of vessels per class, over the 68 scenes and in the test set. The ten classes shown are those used for the reported mAP.
blocks.zh: 图3:每类船只在68个场景和试验集中所占的份额。 所显示的10个类别是用于所报告mAP的类别.

blocks.en: Detection performance of the float model. Before deployment, the detector finds vessels reliably: on the test set it reaches an AP of 86 % and an F1 of 85 % at the deployed threshold, with similar precision and recall (Table 4 ). Naming the vessel type is much harder: one detected vessel in seven gets a wrong type. Classification is also hard to measure on rare classes, so the mAP is averaged over the ten most frequent ones (91 % of the test vessels). Since only detection drives data reduction, the rest of the paper uses detection scores. Their dependence on the threshold is weak around the deployed value: the F1 is maximal near 0.30 and changes by only 2 to 4 points between 0.2 and 0.5 (Fig. 4 a), the threshold mainly trading missed vessels against false alarms (Fig. 4 b). Choosing it is therefore less a matter of accuracy than of which error the mission prefers, which the data reduction exploits.
blocks.zh: 浮标模型的探测性能. 在部署之前,探测器可以可靠地发现船只:在试验装置上,探测器在部署的阈值下达到86%的AP和85%的F1,精确度和回转率相近(表4)。 更难为船型命名:七分之一被检测到的船型有误. 分类也很难在稀有的分级上衡量,因此mAP平均在最常见的10个分级上(91%的试验船). 由于只有检测驱动数据减少,其余的纸张使用检测分数. 它们在所部署值周围对阈值的依赖度很弱:F1最大值接近0.30,在0.2到0.5之间只变化了2到4分(图4 a),这一阈值主要交易被错失的船只来对抗假警报(图4 b). 因此,选择它与其说是一个准确性问题,不如说是一个任务偏好的错误问题,而数据减少正是利用了这个错误。

blocks.zh: 表4:选定操作点的硬件性能(VCK190,批次为6个1024×1024-1024\times 1024平板). 静态:平板休息;动态:处理过程中增加.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Detection on the test set versus confidence threshold, float and quantized models: (a) precision, recall and F1; (b) missed vessels and false alarms. Vertical line: deployed threshold 0.30.
blocks.zh: 图4:测试集上的检测与置信阈值、浮标和定量模型:(a) 精确度、召回和F1;(b) 误入船只和假警报。 垂直线:部署阈值0.30.

blocks.en: Axis 2: Embedded Deployment
blocks.zh: 轴2:嵌入式部署

blocks.en: Detection performance after deployment, compared with the float model. Once quantized and deployed, the detector keeps most of its performance: its AP drops from 86 to 81 % and its F1 from 85 to 81 % (Table 4 ). Quantization does not make it less precise, but more cautious: precision is unchanged or slightly higher, while recall drops by about 8 points. The quantized model gives lower confidence scores to the vessels it finds (three quarters of the vessels found by both models get a lower score), so at a given threshold more of them fall below it, and the recall is lower at every threshold (Fig. 4 ). The loss is therefore largely a shift of the operating point rather than a loss of information: lowering the threshold to 0.10 recovers most of the missed vessels, at the cost of more false alarms, which is the trade-off used for the data reduction. Classification suffers more, for two reasons. Non-maximum suppression is applied per class, so when the model hesitates between two types, two boxes of different classes can remain on the same vessel; the quantized model does this more often, and the extra box counts as a false alarm for its class. In addition, the mAP gives the same weight to every class, so a few rare classes weigh heavily in the loss. For data reduction, which only uses detection, the effect of deployment thus amounts to a recall loss that the threshold can largely compensate.
blocks.zh: 部署后检测性能,与浮标模型相比. 探测器在被量化和部署后,保持了大部分性能:其AP从86%降至81%,F1从85%降至81%(表4)。 量子化并不使其精确度降低,而更谨慎:精度不变或略高,而回想则下降约8分. 被量化的模型给所发现的船只的置信分数较低(两个模型发现的船只有四分之三得到的分数较低),因此在某一个阈值上,更多的船只跌入低于该分数,在每个阈值上被召回的分数更低(图4)。 因此,损失主要是操作点的转变,而不是信息丢失:将阈值降低到0.10,以更多的虚假警报为代价回收了大部分被错失的船舶,这是减少数据所用的取舍. 分类受到更多的伤害,原因有两个。 非最大压制被应用到每类中,因此当模型在两种类型之间犹豫时,两个不同等级的盒子可以留在同一种容器上;被量化的模型更经常地这样做,而外置的盒子则算作其阶级的假警报. 此外,mAP对每个类都给予同样的分量,因此少数稀有类在损失中重. 因此,对于只采用探测方法减少数据而言,部署的效果等于损失的召回,而临界值基本上可以补偿。

blocks.en: Hardware performance. The chain processes a tile in about 17 ms, i.e. an average scene in a few seconds (Table 4 ). The time is split evenly between CPU pre-processing and DPU inference, while post-processing is negligible: the accelerator is not the bottleneck. The pre-processing already uses a look-up table and SIMD instructions, but runs on a single Arm core: spreading it over several cores or overlapping it with inference would nearly double the throughput. The energy is dominated by the static consumption: processing adds only about a seventh to the power at rest, so the energy per scene mostly depends on how long the board is powered. Although measured on the development kit, this static power is representative: that of the final board differs by only about 2 %. Reading the tiles from the board storage, excluded here, is slower than processing them, which confirms that the input data flow must come from the onboard chain rather than from storage.
blocks.zh: 硬件性能. 铁链在大约17ms中处理出一块瓦子,即几秒后的平均场景(表4. 时间在CPU预处理和DPU推论之间平分,而后处理可忽略不计:加速器不是瓶颈. 预处理已经使用一个取景表和SIMD指令,但运行在一个单一的Arm核心上:将其分布在多个核心上或与推想相重叠会使吞吐量几乎翻一番. 能量以静态消耗为主:加工在休息时仅能给动力增加约七分之一,因此每个场景的能耗主要取决于电板的供电时间. 虽然在开发包上进行了测量,但这种静电是具有代表性的:最终板的静电只相差约2%. 从棋盘存储中读取瓷砖,在此被排除在外,比处理速度慢,这证实了输入数据流必须出自棋盘链而非存储.

blocks.en: Axis 3: Data Reduction
blocks.zh: 轴3:数据减少

blocks.en: Missed vessels and false alarms, extrapolated to the scenes. The reduction is evaluated on the 68 whole scenes (Table 6 ). With a perfect detector, the tile mode would keep about a quarter of the scene and the crop mode a few percent; both bounds vary by one to two orders of magnitude between scenes (range in Table 6 ), so the gain depends first on how dense the scene is. Ours are dense, and open-sea acquisitions would give much larger reductions. The real detector moves away from these bounds through its missed vessels and false alarms. Their rates are measured on the test tiles with the quantized detector, as in Table 4 and Fig. 4 but at threshold 0.10, then extrapolated to the scenes by applying them to the tile and vessel counts of each scene; they act very differently in the two image modes (Table 6 ). With crops, every missed vessel is lost: 17 % of the vessels at threshold 0.10. With tiles, a missed vessel is lost only if no other vessel of its tile is detected; in our dense scenes this is rare, so the 7 % of tiles lost hold only 2 % of the vessels. The vessels still lost are isolated ones: on open sea, where a tile usually holds a single vessel, tiles would lose about as many vessels as crops. False alarms, on the other hand, add volume in both modes: a fifth of the downlinked tiles and over a quarter of the crop volume hold only false alarms, less at a higher threshold.
blocks.zh: 错过了船只和假警报 推断到现场 在68个场景中评价了这一减少(表6)。 有了完美的探测器,瓷砖模式将保持大约四分之一的场景和收成模式的几分之;两种范围在场景之间相差一到两个数量级(范围在表6中),所以收益首先取决于场景的密度. 我们的海平面是密集的,海平面的收购将带来更大的削减。 真正的探测器通过它被漏掉的船和假警报而远离这些界限. 如表4和图一所示,其速率用量化探测器在试验瓦上测量。 4,但在0.10分阈值时,然后通过应用到每个场景的瓦片和船体计数来推断出场景;在两种图像模式中它们的行为非常不同(表6. 与农作物相伴,每只被误入海中的船只都丢失了:在0.10分阈值下,有17%的船只丢失了. 有了瓷砖,只有在没有探测到其瓷砖的其他瓷器时,丢失的瓷砖才会丢失;在我们密集的场景中,这种情况是罕见的,所以7%的瓷砖丢失只持有了2%的瓷砖. 仍然丢失的船只是孤立的:在公海上,一瓷砖通常只持有一艘船,瓦片将损失大约与收成一样多的船只. 另一方面,假警报在两种模式中都增加了音量:下行相接的瓦片的五分之一和超过四分之一的作物体积只持有假警报,低于更高的阈值.

blocks.zh: 图5:所保存的下行相接体积与船只对比、量化探测器、置信阈值(标签;大点:0.10) 平面:完美的探测器.

blocks.en: Volume and vessels kept per mode. Put together, these errors give, for each mode, the volume downlinked for an average scene and the share of vessels kept (Table 7 ), i.e. the trade-off between reduction and recall that each mode offers. Metadata take a few kilobytes but show no image; crops give an image of four fifths of the vessels for 3 % of the volume, but lose every missed vessel; tiles keep nearly all vessels for under a third of the volume; selective coding loses none, missed vessels remaining in the compressed background, at a volume set by the assumed compression ratio. At this low threshold, false alarms account for 21 to 28 % of the volume of the first three modes. The threshold moves each mode along its trade-off curve (Fig. 5 ): raising it to 0.30 saves about a fifth of the volume of tiles or crops, but increases the vessels lost, much more for crops than for tiles. The background compression ratios are chosen as representative operating points rather than measured with a codec: lossless CCSDS 122.0 coding needs about 4 to 5 bits per pixel on typical EO test images [ 26 ] , i.e. a ratio of about 2.5 to 3 for 12-bit data, so CR = 4 stands for a mildly lossy background and CR = 20 for a strongly compressed one.
blocks.zh: 数量和船只按模式保存。 总而言之,这些错误为每种模式提供了平均场景的下行量和所保存船只的份额(表7),即减少和召回两种模式之间的取舍。 元数据取出几千字节,但没有显示图像;农作物给出了占体积3%的五分之四船只的图像,但损失了每艘被漏掉的船;瓷砖将几乎所有船只的体积保持在三分之一以下;有选择地编码没有丢失,被漏掉的船留在被压缩的背景中,按照假定的压缩比设定的体积. 在这个低阈值下,假警报占前三种模式音量的21%至28%. 阈值沿取舍曲线(图5)移动出每种模式:将其提升到0.30,节省了约五分之一的瓦片或作物的体积,但增加了所损失的器皿,对作物来说远多于对瓦片. 背景压缩比被选为具有代表性的操作点,而不是用一个编码器来测量:在典型的EO测试图像上,没有丢失的CCDS 122.0编码需要每个像素约4到5比特[26],即12位数据的比例约为2.5到3,因此CR=4代表一个轻微损失的背景,而CR=20代表一个强烈压缩的图像.

blocks.en: Table 7: Downlinked data per mode for an average scene (1.30 GB of raw data), quantized detector at threshold 0.10 , crops with a 32-pixel margin. Selective coding: volume = crop share + + (1 − - crop share)/CR, the background being the scene outside the crops; CR is an assumed compression ratio relative to the 12-bit raw data. Volume of false alarms: with metadata, every detection costs 9 bytes, so this is the share of false detections (25 %). With crops it is slightly higher (28 %): in dense areas, the crops of neighboring vessels overlap and share their 32-pixel margins, whereas each false-alarm crop is isolated and keeps its full margin, so a false alarm costs on average more pixels than a detected vessel.
blocks.zh: 表7:平均场景(1.30克原始数据)每模式下接数据,阈值为0.10的定量探测器,收成为32像素边距. 选择性编码:容积=作物共享++ (1−-作物共享)/CR,背景为作物外的场景;CR是相对于12位原始数据的假设压缩比. 假警报量:有元数据,每个检测成本为9字节,所以这是假检测的比例(25%). 由于作物稍高(28%):在密集地区,相邻船只的作物重叠并分享其32像素的边距,而每个假警报作物都是被隔离的并保持其全能的边距,因此假警报费用平均比探测到的容器多出像素.

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en: Results. The mode and the threshold, set by the mission, decide how much is sent and how many vessels may be lost. The gain is paid mainly in energy, to be weighed against the transmission energy and storage avoided, which depend on how often the satellite acquires and downlinks. As this energy is mostly static, processing faster and powering the processor down between acquisitions, if possible, saves more than lowering dynamic power. The gain is largest if detection runs before storage, which our tile-by-tile pipeline allows.
blocks.zh: 结果。 特派团确定的模式和门槛,决定发送多少和可能损失多少船只。 收益主要以能量支付,与传输能和所避免的存储量进行权衡,这取决于卫星获得和下行链路的频率. 由于这种能量大多是静态的,因此处理速度更快,在收购之间给处理器供电,如果可能的话,节省的不仅仅是降低动态能. 如果在存储之前进行检测 收益是最大的 我们的一瓦一瓦的管道允许的

blocks.en: Limitations. The study covers a single application and a single DPU configuration; since static power dominates, the DPU size should trade its power cost against the throughput it brings. It uses corrected ground products rather than raw data. The scene-level figures extrapolate error rates measured on test tiles, selective coding uses representative compression ratios rather than a codec, and our dense scenes do not represent open sea. Downlink orchestration is not studied.
blocks.zh: 限制。 该研究涵盖一个单一的应用程序和一个单一的DPU配置;由于静电占主导地位,DPU的大小应该用它带来的吞吐量来交换其电费. 它使用经过校正的地产而不是原始数据. 场景平面数字推断出测试牌所测出的错误率,有选择地编码使用代表性的压缩比而不是一个解码器,而我们密集的场景并不代表出海. 下行线管弦乐没有被研究.

blocks.en: Perspectives. The main next step is raw data, with detection integrated among the other bricks of the onboard chain (Fig. 1 ): restoration [ 18 , 19 ] , co-registration, e.g. with a compressed latent reference [ 20 ] , tiler and mosaicer [ 21 ] , and an onboard codec, with open-sea scenes. The modes could be orchestrated over links of different rates, metadata first; the threshold could adapt to the scene density, and the vessel class set the priority (e.g. warships first) once classification is more reliable. Larger networks (e.g. YOLOX-L, at the cost of throughput), quantization-aware training and land or cloud masking could improve detection. Selecting only vessels also discards content other users may need, e.g. damaged buildings [ 16 ] . Open-vocabulary detectors, steered by a text query, could make the selection follow the user’s request rather than a fixed class list; they exist in real time [ 27 ] and for remote sensing [ 28 ] .
blocks.zh: 透视. 下一步主要为原始数据,在机上链的其他砖块(图1)中整合了检测:还原[18,19],并联注册,例如可压缩潜在参考 [20],平板和苔藓 [21],以及机上可编码,并有出海场景. 这些模式可以首先在不同费率、元数据的联系之上加以安排;门槛可以适应场景密度,一旦分类更加可靠,船级就确定优先顺序(例如军舰优先)。 较大的网络(如YOLOX-L,以吞吐量为代价),量化-认知培训和地上或云面掩蔽可以改进探测. 只选择船舶也会丢弃其他用户可能需要的内容,例如受损建筑物[16]。 以文字查询为取向的开口站探测器可以使选择符合用户的要求,而不是固定的类别清单;它们实时存在[27]并用于遥感[28].

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: We studied onboard vessel detection to choose what a satellite downlinks. We built a controlled dataset from Maxar scenes, trained YOLOX-S on it and deployed it, quantized, on a Versal DPU. Deployment preserves most detection performance but shifts the operating point toward lower confidence and recall, which a lower threshold largely compensates; an average scene is processed in a few seconds. The detections support several downlink modes, trading data volume against vessels kept: on our dense harbor and coastal scenes, sending crops divides the volume by about 35 while keeping four vessels in five, and sending tiles divides it by about 3.5 while keeping almost all of them. Our main contribution is to tie these steps together: onboard reduction must be judged from the errors of the deployed model and how each mode absorbs them, not from detection scores alone. Raw data in the complete onboard chain, open sea and other applications are the next steps.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了船上的探测 来选择卫星的下行链路 我们从Maxar的场景建立了控制数据集, 训练YOLOX-S在它上,并部署,量化,一个Versal DPU。 部署能保持大多数探测性能,但将操作点转向信心和召回率较低,而较低的阈值基本上可以补偿这一点;平均场景在几秒钟内得到处理。 探测器支持几种下行链路模式,将数据量与保存的船只进行交易:在我们密集的港口和沿海场景上,发送的作物将体积分出约35分,同时将4个船只分出5分,发送的瓦片则分出约3.5分,同时几乎保留了全部. 我们的主要贡献是把这些步骤捆绑在一起:必须从部署模型的错误和每种模式如何吸收这些步骤,而不是仅仅从检测分数中判断船上的减少。 整个机上链条中的原始数据,开放海等应用是下一步.
